# Collection environment: collection/ (document collection, the training-data
# overlap search, the post-training and RLVR dataset scans, the cohort-F
# re-parse) and design/.
#
# The exact package versions of the environment in which the documents were
# originally collected were not recorded, so this list is unpinned except
# where the code enforces a version. Requires Python 3.10 or later.
#
# External services, not installed by pip:
#   GROBID 0.8.1 (PDF -> TEI for the PDF form of arXiv papers):
#     docker run -d --rm --name grobid -p 8070:8070 --init lfoppiano/grobid:0.8.1
#   (collection/cohortF_reparse.py records the image of the container named
#   "grobid" in its report.)
#
# GPU (one device) is needed only for `collection/olmo2_nonmember_audit.py
# embed` (sentence-transformers), scoring/score_pretreatment_logprobs.py and
# `design/build_injection_manifest.py gen-samples`; torch can be the CPU build
# otherwise.

numpy
# Fast shingle hashing in the corpus scan; collection/olmo2_midtrain_membership.py
# falls back to pure NumPy if numba cannot be imported (numba must support the
# installed numpy version).
numba
zstandard
requests
pandas
scipy
matplotlib
pyarrow
# StackExchange dump archives (renderer calibration only).
py7zr
# StackExchange HTML -> Dolma text renderer.
beautifulsoup4
# Optional: title matching in the older command-line interface of
# collection/olmo2_midtrain_membership.py (not used by the paper's pipeline).
pyahocorasick
transformers
torch
sentence-transformers
huggingface_hub
# Enforced at import by collection/wikipedia_dolma_text.py: the measured
# agreement with Dolma's Wikipedia text holds for this version only.
wikiextractor==3.0.8
